verses.1: And you loved Jehovah your God, and you kept His laws, ordinances, and commandments all the days.
verses.2: Today, you know that those among you who do not understand or see the deeds of Jehovah your God, who do not recognize His mighty hand and His powerful actions, will be punished.
verses.3: And his deeds and actions, which he carried out while he was in Egypt, for Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and for all the land.
verses.4: And when they made horses and chariots for the army of Egypt, and made ships to cross the sea on their backs as they pursued them, then Jehovah destroyed them until today.
verses.5: And he did what he could for you in the desert, until you reached this place.
verses.6: And when Eliab’s sons did what was evil, causing the land to be destroyed and swallowing up their homes, their tents, and everything they owned.
verses.7: For your eyes see all the works of the great God, who has done them.
verses.8: And you shall keep all the commandments that I command you today, so that you may become strong and inherit the land which you are about to possess.
verses.9: And that they may live on this land for ever. For Jehovah has blessed your ancestors, and He has given them and their descendants a land full of milk and honey.
verses.10: For the land that you are about to inherit is not like the land of Egypt. It’s a land from which you have come out. You will plant your seeds there, and they will grow into crops in your fields.
verses.11: And the land that you will cross through is a land of mountains and valleys; it will be filled with water from above.
verses.12: The land that Jehovah your God desires, your eyes shall always be upon it. From the beginning of the year until its end.
verses.13: And if you hear my commands, then you will love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul. And you will serve him with all your being.
verses.14: And I will give you a good harvest at that time, when there is drought and scarcity. You will gather your crops and enjoy your harvest.
verses.15: And I will give you grass to eat in your fields. You will eat and be satisfied.
verses.16: Keep yourselves away from this, so that you may not be deceived. Do not serve other gods and worship them instead.
verses.17: And Jehovah will strike you with a plague, and he will shut up the heavens. There will be no rain on the land, and you will die quickly from the good land that Jehovah has given you.
verses.18: And you shall keep these words in your hearts and minds, and bind them to yourself by your hands. Let them become a reminder for you always.
verses.19: And you shall teach your children to speak with them in your homes, while you are at home. Also, while you are walking on the roads, and while you are lying down or getting up from your bed.
verses.20: And write them on the doors of your houses and on your gates.
verses.21: So that your days and the days of your descendants may be long upon the earth, as Jehovah has promised to their ancestors. He will give them years of plenty on this land.
verses.22: For if you keep all these commandments that I command you to follow, then you will love the LORD your God. You will walk in all His ways and cling to Him.
verses.23: And Jehovah will take away all these nations from before you. You will become a great and powerful nation.
verses.24: All the places where your feet will walk through, from the coast and the desert, all the way to the river Euphrates and beyond to the other sea, will be your boundaries.
verses.25: No one shall stand before you in fear and trembling. Instead, Jehovah your God will give you victory over all those lands you will go through, just as He has said to you.
verses.26: See, I will present to you today both blessings and curses.
verses.27: The blessings that you shall hear in accordance with the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today.
verses.28: And you shall be cursed if you do not listen to the commands of the LORD your God. You shall go astray from the path I command you to follow today, so that you may serve other gods whom you do not know.
verses.29: And it shall be that when Jehovah your God brings you into the land that you are going to inherit, and he grants you blessing upon Mount Gerizim, he will also bring curse upon Mount Ebal.
verses.30: They did not cross the Jordan along the path that leads to the sunset in the land of the Canaanites, who lived in darkness, opposite the pole.
verses.31: For you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of the land that Jehovah your God has given you. You will take it as your inheritance, and you will live in it.
verses.32: And you shall keep to doing all the laws and regulations that I have given you today.
